effect.name: Emboss (Switch)
effect.description: This shader gives an "Emboss" effect by detecting edges at pixels.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo Emboss (Switch) Shader | 2026.08.02 */
parameter.description: This shader gives an "Emboss" effect by detecting edges at pixels.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable determines what the base should be. Setting it to 0 sets the base as the texture of the object on which the effect is applied, and setting it to 1 sets this as the background.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Emboss Size
parameter.description: This variable determines the distance of the normal map size.

parameter.name: Angle
parameter.description: Specifies the rotation angle of the offset.
